newsitem.title: UK: BFI up four points to 1,511 on stronger conditions.
newsitem.headline: BFI up four points to 1,511 on stronger conditions.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) rose four points to 1,511 on Monday.
Brokers reported stronger conditions worldwide for Caper tonnage with 110,000 tonnes coal Hampton Roads/Rotterdam likely to be fixed shortly at close to $6.50.
In the Atlantic a stronger $26.85 no combo (not $27.25 as reported Friday) has been fixed with Sea Diamond for 54,000 tonnes heavy grain by Mitsubishi.
On the other hand Continental booked Panaghiotis A. 73,500 dwt delivery U.S. Gulf about Jan 20 trip China at an easier $15,500 daily plus $350,000 bonus.
